cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The soup's staying in that upside-down bowl. Leave it there while I work out why.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll turn it upright and we can eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Change one thing at a time. Keep the bowl still and turn the spoon over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The soup followed the spoon. It's coming out of the bowl.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon controls down. Point it into the sink, slowly. Please stop trying to serve lunch while I'm establishing gravity.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects B's serving solution into a controlled test and A5 applies the inferred gravity rule under supervision, making S03 govern D150 discovery.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 flowing soup into a practical application of the new rule rather than unrelated magic.
